title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Start as Small-Time Criminals
description: GTA 6 will feature Jason and Lucia beginning their criminal journey as small-time crooks, working their way up to high-value jobs in Rockstar's epic.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Will Start as Small-Time Criminals

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece, new details have emerged regarding the criminal careers of protagonists Jason and Lucia. According to a report by IGN Games, the duo will not start their journey at the top of the criminal underworld. Instead, players will be introduced to Jason and Lucia as small-time criminals who must gradually work their way up to high-value jobs.

The progression from minor offenses to massive, high-stakes heists is a classic narrative device that has resonated with fans of the genre for years. By starting the protagonists off in the lower rungs of the criminal ladder, Rockstar Games is setting up a grounded foundation for their story.

### Building a Criminal Career from the Ground Up

In the grand tradition of open-world crime epics, player progression is often tied directly to the scale of the operations available. Starting as small-time criminals suggests that Jason and Lucia will spend the early portions of the game cutting their teeth on minor jobs, petty crimes, and low-level schemes.

This approach allows players to get intimately familiar with the game mechanics, the environment, and the dynamic between the two main characters before the stakes get impossibly high. It mirrors the classic rise-to-power arc that makes crime dramas so compelling.

### Working Toward High-Value Jobs

Of course, the pinnacle of any modern Grand Theft Auto game is the execution of massive, high-value jobs. IGN Games confirms that while Jason and Lucia begin small, they will eventually gain the opportunity to pull off these lucrative and complex operations.

The transition from petty crimes to high-value targets promises a rewarding gameplay loop. Players will likely see the fruits of their labor reflected in the characters' capabilities, resources, and overall standing within the game's vibrant world.

### Editor's Take

Starting as small-time crooks is a brilliant storytelling and design choice for GTA 6. It grounds Jason and Lucia in a relatable reality before thrusting them into the chaotic, high-stakes world of major heists. This gradual progression ensures that when players finally reach those high-value jobs, the sense of achievement will be immensely satisfying. Rockstar knows how to craft a compelling criminal journey, and this approach hits all the right notes.
